prompt_md: In a board game you roll three dice each turn. On average, how many turns does it take to roll triples (all three dice showing the same number)?
prompt_short: Three dice per turn. Average turns until triples?
hint_md: The first die can show anything.
explain_intuition_md: Three sixes is a 1-in-216 shot, so 216 turns is tempting. But triples can be any number: whatever the first die shows, the other two just have to match it, a 1-in-36 chance.
